description: For x402 sellers: sellercheck every hour for 30 days on one resource, $1 USDC once. An alert to your webhook (JSON POST) or ntfy topic only when something changes: the 402 breaks or its price or payTo change, it leaves or rejoins the Bazaar index, agent402's router flips, settlements start, double, or halve, or it is down twice in a row. Returns a public record page to link from your listing.

method.description: The method it is paid with; default tries GET, then POST

resource.description: The full URL of your x402 resource

webhook.description: A public https URL that gets a JSON POST per alert

name: sellerwatch
title: Watch your x402 resource for 30 days
